message: Scaled 2 of 5 feed rates to 80 %; 1 left as a thread pitch, 2 left because the code means a threading cycle somewhere else, 1 rounded to the decimals it was written with. No machine: profile defaults assumed.

findings.message: F2.0 is a thread pitch (G32), not a feed rate, so it is not scaled: scaling it would cut a different thread.

F2.0 is not scaled: G76 is a threading cycle on another kind of machine or in another G-code system, where this F is the thread lead and not a feed rate. Check the block and scale it by hand if it really is a feed.

F2.0 is not scaled: G92 is a threading cycle on another kind of machine or in another G-code system, where this F is the thread lead and not a feed rate. Check the block and scale it by hand if it really is a feed.
